children: RELEASES UPDATED ADDITIONAL PARAMETERS FOR ITS 2026 TECHNICAL AND ECONOMIC PLAN
SEES AVERAGE COAL SALES PRICE AT 660.97 PLN ZLOTYS PER TONNE AND 661.94 ZLOTYS PER TONNE IN Q1 2027
SETS 2026 CAPITAL EXPENDITURE AT ABOUT 1.9 BILLION ZLOTYS FOR COMPANY
TARGETS UNIT CASH COST OF COAL PRODUCTION AT ABOUT 588 ZLOTY PER TONNE IN 2026
ESTIMATES 2026 COAL PRODUCTION AT 13.3 MILLION TONS, INCLUDING 11.22 MILLION TONS OF COKING COAL
ESTIMATES 2026 COKE PRODUCTION AT 3.26 MILLION TONS
ESTIMATES IMPACT OF PROTECTIVE INSTRUMENTS ON 2026 PAYROLL COSTS WITH OVERHEADS AT ABOUT 272 MILLION ZLOTYS
